BossHealthMultiplier 0.7 -> 0.58

followerHealthMultiplier 0.8 -> 0.7

specialHealthMultiplier 0.8 -> 0.58

pmcHealthMultiplier 1.0 -> 1.0

scavHealthMultiplier 0.7 -> 1.0
